issue_context.title: Race condition in next form page?
comments:
Hey @hn-83,

We have created an internal ticket to look into this which we will be tracking as "N8N-8123"

I'm experiencing a similar issue with the same error: `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'pop')`.

It seems some kind of race condition as sometimes the forms works without problems.

It seems that `lastNodeExecuted` is not always available when evaluating `execution.data.resultData.runData[lastNodeExecuted].pop();` in

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/02880cc5a61ce88b7533cce0519421b4bab34ef8/packages/cli/src/webhooks/waiting-webhooks.ts#L157

version: 1.76.0
mode: queue
hosting: K8s (Cloudflare load balancer + AWS EKS + nginx ingress)
setup: 1 main, 2 workers, 2 webhook. I've also reproduced it with mode=regular and 1 main pod.
